comment: Generated by proto/go/zs TestOperatorVectors. fields, selection, each probe's request_path, verified_node, want and attested, and each chain node's want and skipped are compared exactly.

scenarios.name: a plain token model
every token field is carried
an advertised cache-read rate of 0 is kept
a retention tier this build does not know is dropped
a reasoning model the node says cannot reason projects no flag
an unverifiable weights claim is carried
a dedicated image model serves on its rate alone
a free dedicated image route is served by its flag
in-loop image tools are offered by their rates
each image price field is its own
an image rate alone serves and orders the route
image defaults and caps alone serve nothing
an image-gen-only model offers no edit route or tool
an image-edit-only model offers no gen route or tool
an image-tool base alone offers no tool
a model id that names an object prototype is an ordinary model
tool-call rates and the vendor terms are carried
the minimum charge is carried
a node with no models routes nothing
a model listed twice keeps both ids and the last capacity
a staging node with a broke signer
a funded signer is projected
an attested node
a pass on an untrusted OS image counts as unattested
a pass on a compose that is no published release counts as unattested
a pass with no measurement checks counts as unattested
a TEE node whose evidence failed counts as unattested
an unreachable node
a free model on a node that trusts issuers carries their credits
a free model on a node that trusts no issuer carries none

probe_attestation.name: a node advertising no TEE has no status
verification off leaves every node without a status
a passing verdict is copied, with its attested models
a pass on both checks and a compose pin is attested
a pass on a pinned compose hash without the release match is not attested
a pass on the compose release alone is not attested
a pass with no measurement checks is not attested
a failing verdict is not attested whatever checks it carries
the evidence time is the verdict's, not the advertisement's
the mode is the advertised one, whatever the bundle says
a passing verdict's upstream carve-outs are copied
a signed empty catalog stays an empty list
a failing verdict keeps its tag and evidence time
a verdict with no evidence time reports none
a node with no verified recipient is not fetched, and reads ephemeral_unavailable
ephemeral_unavailable with no advertised time reports none
a relayed probe of a node with no verified recipient asks the relay for nothing
a node advertising no TEE and with no verified recipient has no status
verification off leaves a node with no verified recipient without a status
an error status is fetch_failed at the advertised time
a server error is fetch_failed too
fetch_failed with no advertised time reports none
a body that is not a bundle is fetch_failed
a relative evidence URL is a path on the base
an evidence path is used as given
an absolute evidence URL is used as given
a relayed probe asks the relay for the standard path
a relayed probe ignores an advertised evidence path
a relayed error status is fetch_failed

chain_nodes.name: an active node with no history
a staging node
any non-zero staging byte is staging
the operator's NFD and owner come from its box
ids are read from the box names
every metric is the node's own
revenue windows end on the current day
a ring last written days ago
a ring older than thirty days reads as no revenue
a clock behind the ring reads no revenue
trailing slashes are trimmed from the base URL
an http base URL is accepted
zero padding inside the stored length is trimmed
a base URL with no scheme is skipped
an uppercase scheme is skipped
a non-http scheme is skipped
a bare scheme trims to no URL and is skipped
an empty base URL is skipped
an evicted operator's node is left out
a node's status byte is not read
